tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All the terms and conditions as per PQ Criteria

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: ASRTU Rate Contract sources are eligible to participate in the tender OR Manufacturers/Importers/Authorised dealers with an average annual Turnover of Rs. 2.00 Crores for the preceeding three years i.e., 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 are eligible to participate in the tender, duly supported by the audited statement of accounts i.e., Manufacturing / Trading and Profit loss account, balance sheets for all the three years and Certificate of verification of turnover issued by the CA in support of turnover declared in the prescription format given with the tender documents

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidders should submit the sample of 50mm width X 50 m length of Retro reflective tape roll of all colours with clear making of the manufacturer only at one edge of the tape on or before the opening of technical bid
Commercial offer of the bidder whose sample is approved by Mechanical Engineering Department of BMTC will only be opened subject to fulfilling the pre-qualification criteria
